## Scope

Describe the single behavior this PR adds or changes.

## Quality Gates

- [ ] Public payloads are represented in `shared/models`
- [ ] Unit or contract tests cover local behavior
- [ ] Integration tests cover cross-layer behavior
- [ ] Failure behavior is explicit
- [ ] Events/traces are updated for state-changing actions
- [ ] Docs updated when architecture or workflow changed

## Verification

Commands run:

```bash
make verify
make test-integration
```

## Notes

Risks, open questions, or intentional deferrals.
